name: Cognee
description: Builds queryable memory for agents by turning documents and conversations into a knowledge graph plus vector store, self-hosted or via API and MCP.

skills.name: Memory Ingestion
skills.description: Ingests documents, code and chat history into a combined graph and vector representation for later recall.

skills.name: Graph-Aware Search
skills.description: Answers queries by traversing entity relationships alongside vector similarity for grounded multi-hop recall.

skills.name: Memory MCP Server
skills.description: Serves stored memory to Claude and other MCP clients so agents read and write long-term memory as a tool.
